'''Ellrak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] warrior living on [[Voss]]. During the [[Galactic War]], between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], he was killed in the [[Pelath-Ri Marches]] by the Republic individual on the behest of a [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Findsman/Legends|Findsman]].<ref name="TOR" />
